_note: Run: PYTHONPATH=. .venvs/03_colorization/bin/python bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/extract-features.json -- most of the driver's control logic is standard-library only, BUT the representation mutations (l2/raw normalization) exercise numpy-gated tests (TestFeatureRepresentation, TestRepresentationEndToEnd) that SKIP in the base environment; a skipped test cannot kill a mutant, so these must run under an interpreter that has numpy (any .venvs/<m>) or they falsely survive. This is bin/extract-features.py, the one-run driver that walks every method shipping a feature_provider.py and saves its val features under <out>/<method>/. These mutations prove its guards are not vacuous: discovery matches the provider as a whole filename (a decoy must not count); a method with no checkpoint is skipped with a reason rather than silently dropped; the exit status is nonzero unless every discovered method actually produced features (a skip or an error must never read as success in a paper run); each method runs in its own venv (isolation), a worker's ok result is trusted only when it says ok, and a crashed worker's stderr is carried into the error rather than dropped. The real subprocess path on a real method (which imports the shared adapterlib) is covered by tests.test_method_14_simclrv1.TestFeatureProvider.test_the_isolated_driver_run_extracts_this_method_end_to_end.

targets.label: discovery matches the provider filename as a substring, so a decoy (test_feature_provider.py / feature_provider.py.bak) counts as a provider
a method with no checkpoint is marked ready instead of skipped, so a missing method is dropped silently
a skip no longer fails the run, so a silently missing method reads as success
an error no longer fails the run, so a provider that ran and crashed reads as success
a method's own venv is ignored, so every method runs in the driver's interpreter (defeating isolation)
a worker's ok result is not trusted, so a successful extraction is misreported
a crashed worker's stderr is dropped from the error, hiding why it failed
l2 does not actually normalize (returns the raw features), so the saved feature is not unit-norm as BASIC5_FAIR_v1 requires
the zero-norm guard is dropped (divide by the raw norm), so a zero feature becomes NaN instead of staying zero
an unknown representation is no longer rejected, so a typo silently saves L2 features while the manifest claims otherwise
raw no longer passes the features through, so a raw dump is silently L2-normalized (or errors)
extract_to_dir never applies the representation, so the driver saves the provider's raw vector regardless of --representation
the worker command drops --representation, so the parent's choice is silently ignored across the process boundary
